scope: Purposive product research, not systematic review or GRADE assessment

sources.title: Repeated testing improves long-term retention
sources.supported_observation: Feedback-supported repeated retrieval outperformed repeated study in the reported resident sample.
sources.limitation: Small topic-specific sample; not a HumanScope effect estimate.

sources.title: Comparative effects of test-enhanced learning and self-explanation
sources.supported_observation: Supports testing transfer and delayed retention, not only immediate recall.
sources.limitation: 47 first-year students; full-text methods not appraised.

sources.title: Spatial ability and 3D model colour-coding affect anatomy performance
sources.supported_observation: Colour-coded liver model improved post-test performance relative to photorealistic model in this task.
sources.limitation: 46 participants in liver trial; does not establish universal benefit.

sources.title: Effect of binocular disparity on learning anatomy
sources.supported_observation: Stereoscopic and monoscopic anatomy groups performed similarly in the tested setting.
sources.limitation: 66 learners; not evidence that all VR is ineffective.

sources.title: Effects of instructional strategies using cross sections
sources.supported_observation: Combining cross-sections and radiological images did not show clear recognition benefits in those self-directed studies.
sources.limitation: Mixed populations and older design; do not infer all linked imaging has no value.

sources.title: Exploring cognitive load in anatomy education using fNIRS
sources.supported_observation: Comparable knowledge gains reported for 2D and immersive VR.
sources.limitation: 21 first-year students; exploratory physiological measures do not justify adaptive-product claims.

sources.title: Large Language Model Influence on Diagnostic Reasoning
sources.supported_observation: Providing chatbot access did not significantly improve physician diagnostic reasoning in this trial.
sources.limitation: 50 physicians; task-specific, not a general claim that AI cannot help.

sources.title: From tool to teammate in clinician-AI collaborative workflows
sources.supported_observation: Structured collaborative workflows improved vignette performance versus conventional resources.
sources.limitation: 70 physicians, predominantly internal medicine; no proof of durable student learning or patient outcomes.

sources.title: WFME Basic Medical Education standards
sources.supported_observation: Contextual curriculum and quality framework, not one universal curriculum.

sources.title: AAMC Core EPAs
sources.supported_observation: Professional activities offer an outcome-oriented reference.
sources.limitation: US residency-entry context; web quiz scores cannot establish entrustment.

sources.title: NBME Item-Writing Guide
sources.supported_observation: Use assessment blueprint and sound item-writing principles.
sources.limitation: No full current manual obtained; no rights to reuse protected exam questions inferred.

sources.title: WHO guidance on large multi-modal models in health
sources.supported_observation: AI needs defined governance and oversight.
sources.limitation: Guidance does not certify the product; publication reuse has licensing conditions.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.supported_observation: Accessibility target includes keyboard, focus, alternatives to dragging and motion controls.
sources.limitation: No conformance claim without implementation testing.

sources.title: Complete Anatomy
sources.supported_observation: Atlas and educator resources illustrate integrated teaching workflows.
sources.limitation: Not independent effectiveness evidence; no assets copied.

sources.title: AMBOSS student exams
sources.supported_observation: Question bank, library and analytics integrated in a study journey.
sources.limitation: Not comparative proof of efficacy or pricing.

sources.title: RADPrimer
sources.supported_observation: Imaging curriculum and progress tracking offer a product reference.
sources.limitation: Vendor description only; no content reuse authorized.
